}}'''Efraim Yamada''' is a Banner-General in the [[Seanchan]] army and is a member of the low Blood.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Efrain Yamada}}

== Appearance ==
His hair is cut in the bowl-and-tail. He is graying and tall, with broad shoulders and lean hips. He still holds some of his beauty from youth.

== Activities ==
He has been courting the maid [[Riselle]] in [[Ebou Dar]]. They decide to get married to each other and he buys her a vineyard in the [[Rhannon Hills]] as a wedding gift.

He reports to [[Lunal Galgan]] on the status report of [[Rodel Ituralde]]'s army and how General [[Turan]]'s army has now been surrounded by another force coming from behind.

He is present when [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] warns King [[Beslan Mitsobar]] not to cause a revolt against the Seanchan.
